title: An internal estimate shows its stamp
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Make sure the Internal Work Orders setting is on in Settings > Work Orders.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer A, flagged as an Internal customer.
  • Have a new internal work order for this test, work order 1, for internal customer A, in Estimate, with one approved labor line of 2.0 hours.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Work order 1 opens.

Step 2:

  • The estimate shows the stamp for an internal work order and no prices or totals.

The PRD says the estimate of these work orders carries the NO CHARGE stamp and that the closed document of an internal work order carries the INTERNAL stamp; which word the internal estimate shows waits on the PO.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Internal Work Orders (PRD)", Confluence 942243841, version 1.0 final (9 Nov 2026, Milos Vasic), read 12 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-11665, story SV-11759 (Story 2, An internal or no-charge work order from creation to Close), story SV-11760 (Story 3, Close an internal or no-charge work order)

  • S2-R4: “Lines on an internal or no-charge work order show quantity, cost (parts) and hours (labor) and no sell prices: the Rate, Margin and Total columns of the lines table (a part's sell price sits in Rate) and the Sell price, Rate and Margin fields of the line and part dialogs are hidden and not required; there is no work order total, tax, fee or discount block; the shop supplies block is the flat amount of Story 10. Cost is shown only to users with 'See Financial Data', as cost is today; other users see quantity and hours. The estimate and invoice documents for these work orders show the same and carry the NO CHARGE stamp and, on a no-charge work order, the line "Category: [Category]" under the stamp; the shop-floor Print Work Order is unchanged (it carries no prices today). Board cards and the statistics that show a work order total show "No Charge" in place of the amount.”
  • S3-R5: “The Finance tab of a closed work order shows the NO CHARGE document: the masthead as on the invoice today (letterhead left, the shop logo in the centre slot, the document block "Internal Work Order [number]" or "No Charge Work Order [number]" with the date right), and under the masthead line, on the left and never over the logo, the INTERNAL or NO CHARGE stamp with the line "Category: [name]" and, when set, "· Original work order [number]" (a link in ShopView, plain on the PDF), Bill to the customer, the asset block, labor lines with hours only, parts lines with quantity and cost only (cost under 'See Financial Data'), a Summary with Parts cost (one number: stock parts plus special orders and sublet, at the amounts of S3-R2, core cost excluded, S2-E7), Shop supplies (when above $0.00) and Labor hours (the labor hours on the lines), and no tax, total, payments, balance or signature block; with Download, Print and Email (the recipient field is empty; the user types the shop's own address or any other; never automatically). The Customer PO field is not required. The internal invoice carries the work order number, as every invoice does today; no number is consumed or skipped. Parts cost on the document and in the report is fixed at Close: a vendor bill entered, edited or deleted after Close posts its own amounts to the work order's expense account (S7-R3) and changes neither the document nor the report. Email uses the invoice email template of today (it carries no amounts) with the subject "Internal Work Order [number]" or "No Charge Work Order [number]".”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.

Design canvas "Internal Work Orders · All flows v6" (https://claude.ai/artifact/5jHR3nLeDinzks1viREFuo), version 1794484794-2031, read and rendered 12 Nov 2026: boards "03 Work order · in progress" (page "Flow 1 · Create and close"), "14 In progress: cost and hours, no prices" (page "Happy flow v6"), "07 Finance tab · open estimate" (page "Flow 2 · No charge on a customer's work order"), "10 Board · internal card" (page "Flow 4 · Find internal and no-charge work orders").
